Naujamiestis Karaite Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Panevėžio apskritis, Lithuania

Not demolished. This record shares its full historical narrative with the separately documented Naujamiestis Jewish Cemetery elsewhere in this collection — both describing the town's founding by Karaites, brought from Crimea by Grand Duke Vytautas in the 15th century, and its later shift toward a rabbinic Jewish majority. Notably, this record's coordinates are identical to that companion record's, suggesting the two sites may be the same or immediately adjacent grounds, distinguished in the source data mainly by their Karaite versus rabbinic designation.
